metadata.title: MyRoofPortal — document-based comparison and question handoff
metadata.source_scope: Seven unique supplied PDFs from nine uploads. Manufacturer language is limited to the supplied editions and conditional on the exact project. No live approval, warranty eligibility or installation certification has been performed.
metadata.comparison_scope: Manual structured comparison and source-linked question generation. No OCR, upload service, account system, outbound email, automatic compliance decision, contractor ranking or estimated cost adjustment.
metadata.data_handling: Offline prototype keeps entries in memory. Explicit JSON export/import provides local retention. No automatic storage or network transmission.
metadata.deduplication: 15 overlapping raw rows map to existing canonical criteria; one unsourced prior-context preference is excluded. The 120 raw extracted entries and all 22 original questions remain in the data archive.
metadata.source_precedence: Applicable original manufacturer text takes precedence over contractor summary for a product-specific claim. Unresolved applicability requires human review.
